import pandas as pd

# Get day_1_5 and overnight peak data from S2
trips = tables['trips']
pier = tables['pier']

# Filter to Season 2, day_1_5 class
s2_d1_5 = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 2) & (trips['cls'] == 'day_1_5')].copy()
s2_d1_5['share'] = s2_d1_5['yt'] / (s2_d1_5['anglers'] + 0)  # simplified share (no competitor info here)

# Group by fishing date to get daily averages
daily_d1_5 = s2_d1_5.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'share': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
daily_d1_5.columns = ['doy', 'total_yt', 'total_anglers', 'avg_share']
daily_d1_5 = daily_d1_5.sort_values('doy')

# Same for overnight
s2_overnight = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 2) & (trips['cls'] == 'overnight')].copy()
s2_overnight['share'] = s2_overnight['yt'] / (s2_overnight['anglers'] + 0)

daily_overnight = s2_overnight.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'share': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
daily_overnight.columns = ['doy', 'total_yt', 'total_anglers', 'avg_share']
daily_overnight = daily_overnight.sort_values('doy')

# Get water temperature data
pier_s2 = pier[pier['ts_season'] == 2].copy()
daily_wtmp = pier_s2.groupby('ts_doy')['wtmp_c'].mean().reset_index()
daily_wtmp.columns = ['doy', 'wtmp_c']

# Merge all and find peaks
merged = daily_d1_5.merge(daily_overnight, on='doy', suffixes=('_d1_5', '_overnight'), how='outer')
merged = merged.merge(daily_wtmp, on='doy', how='left')
merged = merged.sort_values('doy')

# Print high-scoring windows
print("=== DAY_1_5 peaks (avg_share >= 0.3) ===")
print(merged[merged['avg_share_d1_5'] >= 0.3][['doy', 'avg_share_d1_5', 'avg_share_overnight', 'wtmp_c']].to_string())

print("\n=== OVERNIGHT peaks (avg_share >= 0.3) ===")
print(merged[merged['avg_share_overnight'] >= 0.3][['doy', 'avg_share_d1_5', 'avg_share_overnight', 'wtmp_c']].to_string())

print("\n=== September peaks (d206-d243) ===")
sept = merged[(merged['doy'] >= 206) & (merged['doy'] <= 243)]
print(sept[['doy', 'avg_share_d1_5', 'avg_share_overnight', 'wtmp_c']].to_string())

print("\n=== October peaks (d287-d303) ===")
oct = merged[(merged['doy'] >= 287) & (merged['doy'] <= 303)]
print(oct[['doy', 'avg_share_d1_5', 'avg_share_overnight', 'wtmp_c']].to_string())
